_pair_note: n1_contained_numpy_satellite and n2_load_bearing_numpy differ in EXACTLY ONE field, TOOL_INTEGRATION_DEPTH.numpy. Both point at the same real JAX and PyTorch legs, which both witness. n1 says supportive and is admitted; n2 says load_bearing and is rejected by three_engine_seal R1. Isolating the rule to one field is the point: nothing else can be blamed for the difference in verdict.
_claim_kind_note: field_only is the SAME claim_kind b1_field_only_self_exempt.json bypassed the gate with. b1 declared its own exemption and is PARKED; this receipt carries witnessed engine execution and is admitted. The label no longer decides anything — the evidence does.
claim_under_test: spectral gap of a fixed 3x3 Hermitian matrix, computed independently by JAX and PyTorch
numpy_usage: probe_numpy_satellite.py imports numpy, reads what the two engine legs printed, and reports the spread between them. It computes no observable of its own, so deleting it changes no claimed value.
